description: This file contains functions for moving nodes and parent nodes within a rich text editor, specifically for a project called Notesnook. It includes logic for resolving nodes, swapping nodes with siblings, and moving nodes up or down in the document structure.

methods.name: resolveNode
methods.description: Resolves the current node or its parent based on selection context within the editor.

methods.name: resolveParentNode
methods.description: Finds the closest valid parent node of the current selection.

methods.name: swapNodeWithSibling
methods.description: Swaps the specified node with its sibling node in the document structure.

methods.name: moveNodeUp
methods.description: Moves the selected node up in the document hierarchy.

methods.name: moveNodeDown
methods.description: Moves the selected node down in the document hierarchy.

methods.name: moveParentUp
methods.description: Moves the parent of the selected node up.

methods.name: moveParentDown
methods.description: Moves the parent of the selected node down.
